_comment: MCP servers that bin/mcp-run.sh can launch but this repo does not contain.
Tracked on purpose: a command line is not a secret, and the whole point is
that the launch path stops living in an agent runtime's config file where
nothing tests it and nothing rebuilds it (opskit #80, #105).
Key   = server name, matching its section in vault-map.local.json.
Must not collide with an in-repo mcp/<name>-mcp-server.py.
command = argv, launched with the vault-resolved secrets in its environment.
install = how to obtain it, for the operator that --check tells to install it.
Keep this file free of environment names, hostnames and vault identifiers
(docs/client-data-policy.md) — those belong in the gitignored layers.

why: The sanctioned path for all RouterOS work (AGENTS.md routes MikroTik
through @mikrotik, which is restricted to mikromcp_* tools).
mikromcp reads its device list from ~/.mikromcp/routers.yaml and takes
variables — its credentials.source: "vault" is declared in the schema
but unimplemented, and raises VAULT_NOT_SUPPORTED. So the vault
resolution has to happen here, at launch, one prefix per router.
Vikunja task management (the primary task system per global memory).
installed globally. Needs VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN (resolved from vault-map) plus
VIKUNJA_API_BASE (set in the opencode.json MCP entry's environment block;
the instance URL is not a secret). See ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json.
